metadata.description: A tenant's Junction check score fell by at least 5 points since its previous run. Resource API version: Microsoft.SecurityInsights 2023-02-01 (stable).
Name of the Sentinel-enabled Log Analytics workspace.
Rule id (a GUID). Reuse it to update the rule.

properties.description: A tenant's Junction check score fell by at least 5 points since its previous run.
properties.query:
// Alert when a tenant's latest score is at least `threshold` points below its previous run.
let threshold = 5.0;
JunctionCheck_CL
| where isnotnull(Score)
| summarize Score = take_any(Score), TenantLabel = take_any(TenantLabel) by EntraTenantId, RunId, TimeGenerated
| order by EntraTenantId asc, TimeGenerated asc
| extend PreviousScore = iff(prev(EntraTenantId) == EntraTenantId, prev(Score), real(null)),
         PreviousRunId = iff(prev(EntraTenantId) == EntraTenantId, prev(RunId), "")
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by EntraTenantId
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| where isnotnull(PreviousScore) and PreviousScore - Score >= threshold
| project TimeGenerated, EntraTenantId, Tenant = iff(isempty(TenantLabel), EntraTenantId, TenantLabel), RunId, PreviousRunId, PreviousScore, Score, Drop = round(PreviousScore - Score, 1)
